summary: Build PMO governance, maturity assessment, and dashboard skills in 5 days. Learn practical tools, templates, and roadmaps with TrainingCred.
lede: PMO governance and maturity assessment help teams define an operating model, clarify decision rights and evaluate current capability. Designed for professionals in PMO coordination, project delivery or portfolio oversight, the training covers maturity scoring, governance controls and consistent intake and reporting. Participants practice building a maturity scorecard, governance RACI and prioritized roadmap to present findings and improvement actions to leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in project delivery, portfolio oversight, or PMO coordination and need to formalize governance and maturity assessment.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a working knowledge of project or portfolio reporting, and examples of PMO or governance documents if available. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet use and presentation tools will help you complete the dashboard and roadmap exercises efficiently.
